name: E2E UI Tests on Kind

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '**.js'
      - '**.ts'
      - '**.yaml'
      - '**.yml'
      - '**.sh'
      - '**/playwright/**'
      - '**/tests/**'
      - '**/scripts/**'
      - '**/k8s/**'

jobs:
  e2e-kind:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: /tmp/.playwright-browsers
      DEBUG: playwright:*
      PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_DIR: playwright-report
      PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR: playwright-output
      PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080
      KEYCLOAK_URL: http://localhost:8080/auth
      KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID: kagenti-client
      KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Set up kind
        uses: engineerd/setup-kind@v0.5.0
        with:
          version: v0.20.0

      - name: Create kind cluster
        run: kind create cluster --name kagenti-e2e

      - name: Deploy backend
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f k8s/backend-deployment.yaml
          kubectl apply -f k8s/backend-service.yaml

      - name: Wait for backend deployment
        run: |
          kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/backend --timeout=120s
          echo "Backend deployment is ready"

      - name: Port-forward backend service
        run: |
          kubectl port-forward svc/backend 8080:80 &
          echo "Port-forward started on localhost:8080"
          # Give port-forward some time to establish
          sleep 10

      - name: Run Playwright UI tests
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh
          scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL }}
          KEYCLOAK_URL: ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_URL }}
          KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID: ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID }}
          KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          DEBUG: ${{ env.DEBUG }}
          PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_DIR: ${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_DIR }}
          PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR: ${{ env.PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/

      - name: Upload Playwright output
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-output
          path: playwright-output/

      - name: Clean up port-forward
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill -f "kubectl port-forward" || true

      - name: Delete kind cluster
        if: always()
        run: kind delete cluster --name kagenti-e2e
